newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ MIDnz fund to list on June 16.
newsitem.headline: NZ MIDnz fund to list on June 16.

text.p: Units of the New Zealand Mid Cap Index Fund, will commence trading on the New Zealand Stock Exchange on June 16, the manager of the new passive fund said on Friday.
Stan Martin, secretary of Passive Funds Management, said the listing followed the successful flotation of the fund, which closed on May 30 and raised NZ$13.73 million over 825 unitholders.

"The portfolio of 35 securities has been purchased on the market over the last two weeks. The pricing date in terms of the prospectus has been set at the close of business on June 12 when the NZ Mid Cap Index stood at 1,911.72," Martin said in a statement.
Each MIDnZ unitholder would receive for each $1 subscribed $1.0063 worth of MIDnZ units based on prices at the close of the market on June 12, he said.

"This means that an individual investing $10,000 (after deduction of the application fee) will receive MIDnZ units valued at approximately $10,063. This represents 7.231 million of MIDnz units issued at a price per unit of $1.89958."
